title: Quality & Reliability, Intern Summer 2027
description: Lightmatter is leading the revolution in AI data center infrastructure, enabling the next giant leaps in human progress. The company invented the world’s first 3D-stacked photonics engine, Passage™, capable of connecting thousands to millions of processors at the speed of light in extreme-scale data centers for the most advanced AI and HPC workloads. Lightmatter raised $400 million in its Series D round, reaching a valuation of $4.4 billion. We will continue to accelerate the development of data center photonics and grow every department at Lightmatter! If you're passionate about tackling complex challenges, making an impact, and being an expert in your craft, join our team of brilliant scientists, engineers, and accomplished industry leaders. Lightmatter is (re)inventing the future of computing with light! About this job This team makes sure Lightmatter’s products hold up in the real world AI data centers. As an intern you’ll build and automate test setups, run real reliability experiments, and present your data to the engineers who design the product — mentored by our reliability and test team in the Mountain View lab. Responsibilities: Perform reliability and characterization tests on photonic and electronic hardware. Set up test stations and write Python automation scripts and instrument drivers. Analyze test data and present findings to key stakeholders. Support failure analysis by isolating root causes and documenting results. Maintain test procedures and contribute to reliability reports and qualification plans. Requirements: Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field Basic knowledge of test automation tools, python is preferred Familiarity with hardware testing equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, and thermal sensors Understanding of basic electronics, circuits, and embedded systems Strong problem-solving and analytical skills Ability to work in a hands-on lab environment Willingness and curiosity to learn from an exciting team! Preferred Qualifications Coursework or projects in optics, photonics, or semiconductor devices Experience with instrument control protocols (SCPI, VISA, GPIB) or data-acquisition hardware Exposure to reliability or qualification concepts (e.g., thermal cycling, HTOL, failure analysis) Experience working in a lab environment Our internship hourly rates are a standard pay determined based on the position and your location, year in school, degree, and experience. Hourly Rate in USD $43 $47 USD Benefits Comprehensive Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental Vision) Retirement Savings Matching Program Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary AD D) Generous Time Off (Vacation, Sick Public Holidays) Paid Family Leave Short Term Long Term Disability Training Development Commuter Benefits Flexible, hybrid workplace model Equity grants (applicable to full-time employees) Benefits eligibility may vary depending on your employment status and location. Lightmatter recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law. Export Control Candidates should have capacity to comply with the federally mandated requirements of U.S. export control laws.

title: IBM Z Engineering System Test QA/Test Developer Intern - Poughkeepsie, NY - 2027
description: As a QA/Test Engineer intern at IBM, you’ll get to work on the systems that are driving the future of computing. Join our team of creators – the people who help move IBM forward by using their imagination to envision solutions, curiosity to experiment with new ideas, and put their ever-growing skills into action for customers to make better decisions with greater speed on the most trusted platform in today’s market. IBM has openings for QA/Test Engineer interns in our Z Engineering System Test organization to test and provide customer support for hardware and firmware that make up our industry-leading IBM products. We are an elite team of engineering professionals that pioneer innovations for the cutting-edge microprocessors and hardware used in IBM Z Systems. Test Engineers participate in various aspects of the test and support process such as but not limited to Assist in the testing of mainframe hardware components including processors, memory modules, and I/O systems Collaborate with firmware and systems engineering teams to ensure seamless hardware-software integration Help diagnose and resolve hardware issues through testing, debugging, and failure analysis Support lab testing efforts, including hardware bring-up, functional verification, and environmental testing Contribute to technical documentation for procedures, and test results Designing and implementing test automation to deliver test cases into automated regression buckets Fundamental education in hardware, software, or testing Strong communication skills Passion to pursue career path in engineering Growth minded, trusted, team focused, courageous, resourceful, and outcome focused Python coding and scripting Strong knowledge or experience working with Linux Experience building and deploying containerized applications Experience with IBM System Z in any capacity, including operating systems such as z/VM and/or z/OS. Advanced knowledge of Linux system administration Experience with OpenShift Container Platform Experience with Linux KVM United States Infrastructure & Technology Hybrid Internship POUGHKEEPSIE, US POUGHKEEPSIE (0147) International Business Machines Corporation Communication Education Engineering Linux Linux System Administration Operating Systems Python Quality Assurance Scripting Software Testing IBM z/Operating System Coding Passion Hardware Virtual Machine IBM Z Systems OpenShift
